description: Dynamita SUMO is a wastewater-process simulation environment for municipal and industrial treatment. Its models use an Excel-based process language and cover biological nutrient removal and several reactor configurations. This resource is provided by Dynamita. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): commercial licence (Dynamita SUMO). Commercial pricing is on request and was not verified. Limitation: Open process source does not mean the entire application has an open-source licence. Keep it distinct from the traffic simulator also named SUMO. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
